title: Coworking spaces in Kozhikode with day passes
description: Find short-term coworking desks in Kozhikode, with day-pass options, booking links and map searches.
intro: A desk for a single workday can be useful when you are travelling, between offices or working away from home. These Kozhikode-area spaces advertise daily access directly or through a booking provider. Check current prices, taxes, booking requirements and facilities before travelling; advertised workspace hours do not necessarily apply to a day pass. Map links are searches, not verified pins.

ordering.explanation: Places are listed alphabetically by name because comparable, source-checked quality and price information is not available for a fair ranking.

entries.name: B Lounge Workspace

entries.address: HiLITE Business Park, Tower 2, second floor, Kozhikode

facts.label: Short-term access

facts.label: Booking
